From fittings and rehearsals to the meticulous work behind every detail, a mosaic of backstage moments revealing the creativity, emotion and exceptional #DGFattoAMano craftsmanship behind the performance.  
A journey where music intertwined with the vision of #DolceGabbana.

description: The celebrations of #DGAltaGioielleria, #DGAltaModa and #DGAltaSartoria culminated at La Plage Resort Taormina, with Isola Bella and Parco Archeologico Naxos Taormina framing a special live performance by #JLo. Delivering some of her most beloved hits, the artist brought her extraordinary energy to an evening celebrating Sicily’s beauty and rich cultural heritage. Throughout the performance, JLo showcased a succession of distinctive looks from the exclusive #DolceGabbana Alta Moda costum creations, spanning draped silk chiffon silhouettes illuminated by jewelled floral motifs and multicoloured gemstones, alongside a lace bodysuit accompanied by a black lace veil, exquisitely embroidered with Baroque-inspired motifs, and a gold-tone crown embellished with black crystals. A celebration of music, creativity and #DGFattoAMano artistry in one extraordinary finale.

description:
The inspiration behind the #DGAltaModa Collection is rooted in Sicilian terraces, where ornamental terracotta pots safeguard the secrets of timeless villas. As if shaped by the hands of a master potter, oranges and lemons emerge through an interplay of high and low reliefs. Corsets and silhouettes are transformed into creations of pure beauty, immersed in the Radicepura gardens. Glossy leaves and delicate orange blossoms intertwine in a continuous embrace, enveloping the bodice and extending into sleeves, inspired by the sinuous silhouette of an ancient vase. Fruits and tendrils, recreated through the sculptural texture of duchesse fabric and embellished with crystals, rest lightly upon clouds of layered tulle.

description:
The 'Dal Cuore Alle Mani: Dolce&Gabbana' exhibition celebrates #MadeInItaly and the art of #FattoAMano through every room. From Lunati Manufacturing's Baroque-inspired creations, blending purity and extravagance, to Ceramica Bevilacqua, Salvo Sapienza and Gianfranco Fiore revival of the iconic Sicilian cart, a vibrant symbol of the island's cultural heritage. Orsoni Venezia's Byzantine-inspired mosaics and Arianese Allestimenti's divine set designs grace the 'Dream of Divinity' room, while Venetian craftsmanship shines through Barbini Specchi Veneziani and Barovier&Toso Murano’s glasswork. Lastly, Tecnolegno Allestimenti curates a refined atmosphere where architecture and Italian artistry intertwine in every #DGAltaModa creation.

Book your tickets now at https://bit.ly/DalCuore_AlleMani to experience the exhibit at Palazzo Reale Milano until August 4th.

Each piece reflects #MadeInItaly craftsmanship and centuries-old traditions, harmonizing textures and unique embellishments to evoke the island's enigmatic past with the artistry synonymous with #DolceGabbana.

description:

description:
Set amidst the ruins of the Archaeological Park of Nora, the #DGAltaModa showcase is enriched by the installation "Nora Mirage" by Phillip K. Smith III. An artist celebrated for his light and space-based creations, he integrates his work into the park's historical context, reflecting the unique beauty of Nora. His inspiration from the Alta Moda 2024 collection’s metaphysical aesthetic brings a contemporary edge to the ancient site, creating a dialogue between the past and the present. This artistic collaboration exemplifies #DolceGabbana's dedication to heritage and innovation.

Follow the show live, tonight at 8PM CEST, at https://bit.ly/DGAltaModa_Sardegna2024_

#PKS3 #PhillipKSmithIII #NoraMirage

description:

description:
Casa Dolce&Gabbana at Zhangyuan in Shanghai stands as a cultural and artistic landmark within the city’s largest Shikumen complex. This distinctive two-floor establishment showcases #DolceGabbana’s commitment to craftsmanship and cultural exchange. From the “Sicily Garden” and innovative “Hologram Room” to the curated “DG Cinema” and exhibition halls, every space reflects the brand's dedication to blending its heritage with contemporary creativity. The “NERO: The Colors of Dolce&Gabbana” exhibition and #DGGenD Project, underscore support for emerging local designers Wu Jie and Xu Mingyu, fostering a platform where Chinese and Italian culture meet through fashion, design, and immersive experiences.

Casa Dolce&Gabbana exemplifies enduring vision of elegance and innovation in a global context.

description:
Preserving heritage, inspiring art: a dialogue with Florence Müller, curator of ‘Dal Cuore Alle Mani: Dolce&Gabbana’ exhibition at Palazzo Reale in Milan. 
 
“I believe Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana are among the couturiers most inspired by Italian culture and art, and those who represent it most faithfully. The exhibition pays tribute to all these narratives, to everything that constitutes Italy's cultural richness. It also demonstrates one thing: that the past is not dead.” 
 
Immerse yourself in the meticulously curated sections, each unveiling the opulent creations of #DGAltaModa, #DGAltaSartoria, and #DGAltaGioielleria, from the 7th of April to the 31st of July at Palazzo Reale Milano.  
 
Book your tickets now at https://bit.ly/DalCuoreAlleMani_
 
#DolceGabbana #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly
title: Dal Cuore Alle Mani: Dolce&Gabbana - Florence Müller

A #DolceGabbana narrative shaped by cultural heritage, spanning from traditional #MadeInItaly craftsmanship to contemporary visual arts, amidst the backdrop of Italy's profound heritage. description:
TUXEDO 

The new #DGFW24 Women’s Collection. 
Rooted in #DolceGabbana’s sartorial heritage, each piece is an ode to femininity seamed in velvet and lace, mesh and chiffon. 

Mariacarla Boscono walks in a wool Spencer jacket, featuring satin Rever and buttons, a gathered bodysuit in satin and Chantilly lace, adorned with a delicate bow at the waist and accessorized with satin gloves, a Marlene handbag and satin T-bar sandals. 

Natasha Poly walks in the iconic Dolce jacket in mesh with satin Rever and buttons, paired with a balconette bra, high-waisted satin culottes and net pencil skirt, finished with cap, satin gloves and T-bar sandals. 

Irina Shayk wears a net dress with puff sleeves, accentuated at the waist with a satin tuxedo band, subtly revealing a lingerie set featuring a bralette and satin culottes. The ensemble is complemented with T-bar sandals and satin gloves.

Eva Herzigova walks in an open-front silk chiffon Chemisier dress with satin Rever and puffed sleeves, revealing a balconette top and satin culottes. Paired with satin gloves and slingback shoes in satin adorned with double bows.

Amber Valletta dons a feathered coat with satin Rever and waistband, satin gloves, black satin slingback shoes and a black satin hat with a veil.

Soundtrack: "Murphy's Law" by Roisin Murphy 

Discover more exclusive content and rewatch the #DolceGabbana show at https://bit.ly/DGFW24_Tuxedo

description:
Capturing the essence of the 1960s, the latest #DolceGabbana collection embodies a cosmopolitan woman interpreting the era's elegance with a touch of irony. Graphic opulence is expressed through clean, linear shapes, with roses, anemones, and floral bouquets adorning stretch satin sheath dresses and printed silk chiffon. The result is a seamless blend of feminine silhouettes and ethereal volumes.

description:
The latest Men’s Collection by #DolceGabbana captures the enduring freedom of the sea. Inspired by the enigmatic Lighthouse Man, the collection features reimagined sailor trousers, multi-pocketed jackets, and updated jumpers. Prints showcase simplicity with sailor stripes, stormy waves, anchors, and cardinal points, while denim reflects 2000s' style.

Tailored elements reveal a poetic side through elongated silhouettes and satin shirts. Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana emphasize new masculine sensuality with precise proportions. An ode to the sea resonates through fabrics, prints and shapes, embodying the essence of a modern, free-spirited seafaring man.

description:
The story of Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana is one steeped in synergy and creativity. The two designers' paths first crossed over the phone in 1980, and four years later, with a limited budget and a shared passion to follow their dreams, they created what was destined to become an example of Italian excellence around the world. 

Behind the scenes of “The Strength of Connections”, the new institutional campaign of TIM by Oscar-winning director Giuseppe Tornatore with the glorious soundtrack of Ennio Morricone. A project by TIM and #DolceGabbana that tells the story of the connection between Stefano Gabbana and Domenico Dolce and shows how connectivity helps us achieve our most ambitious projects. 

#LaForzaDelleConnessioni
title: The Strength of Connections: Behind The Scenes

description:
The story of Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana is one steeped in synergy and creativity. The two designers' paths first crossed over the phone in 1980, and four years later, with a limited budget and a shared passion to follow their dreams, they created what was destined to become an example of Italian excellence around the world. 
 
A young Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana who meet, connect and realise their dreams. This is the story of “The Strength of Connections”, the new institutional campaign of TIM by Academy Award-winning director Giuseppe Tornatore accompanied by the notes of an unpublished piece by Academy Award-winning composer Ennio Morricone. 
 
The partnership between TIM and #DolceGabbana underlines the importance of connection that becomes a human relationship, helping us get closer, overcome distances and find the strength and motivation to achieve our most ambitious projects. 
 
#LaForzaDelleConnessioni

description:
Looking back at the extraordinary collection by South Korean designer Miss Sohee, showcased at Saloni Alta Sartoria in Corso Venezia 13, Milan, with the full support of Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana. 
  
Inspired by Korean folk art ‘Minhwa’, Sohee Park interpreted fascinating elements of nature and traditional colours in the exquisite hand-embroidered designs featuring tiger motifs, magpies, flowers, butterflies, ocean waves and mountains, all enriched with Swarovski crystals.  
  
In addition to the #DGFattoAMano aesthetic, sustainability is also one of the collection’s fundamental elements, combining locally sourced Hansan Mosi, fine ramie woven fabrics from the Hansan region of South Korea, and upcycled plant-based materials from the #DolceGabbana archive. 
  
#DGxMissSohee

The ultimate embodiment of love and beauty, #DGAltaGioielleria creations illuminate the rooms of Palazzo Ducale with the unique and impeccable work of Italian craftsmen. A true expression of #DGFattoAMano, and a timelessly exquisite interpretation of Italian excellence.

Palazzo Vecchio, the heart of the city, founded in 1299, features one of the most wonderful rooms in Florence: the Salone dei Cinquecento, that hosted the Alta Sartoria fashion show. 

As an emblem of the Renaissance, decorated by architect Giorgio Vasari and commissioned by Cosimo I de’ Medici, this magnificent hall featured a floor decoration of the symbol of the city: the Florentine lily. 

#DGLovesTuscany #Pittimmagine #DGAltaSartoria #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly

description:

The magnificent Villa Bardini will host the Alta Moda fashion show tonight. 
The perfect backdrop for an event that celebrates the values of Made in Italy and Fatto a Mano, in the city of craftsmanship and the Renaissance.

description:
Dolce&Gabbana and the Regione Sicilia have decided to bring to some of the most beautiful Sicilian squares the film, “Devotion”, to celebrate and valorise the island. 
 Siracusa, Caltagirone, Castellammare del Golfo, Palermo and Polizzi Generosa will be the setting for the screening of the film directed by Giuseppe Tornatore with unreleased music by the unforgettable Ennio Morricone that tells the story of Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana’s infinite love for the beauty and culture of Sicily. 
 
August 1st: Siracusa, the historic city rich with timeless Greek ruins 
August 5th: Caltagirone, renowned for its unique ceramics 
August 8th: Castellammare del Golfo, the coastal town with breath-taking views of the sea 
August 12th: Palermo, the capital of Sicily notable for its mix of cultures and splendid architecture 
August 16th: Polizzi Generosa, the birthplace of Domenico Dolce and a deep source of inspiration for Dolce&Gabbana. 
 
The screenings will be accompanied by traditional settings of Sicilian folklore and food and wine exhibitions under the supervision of the master pastry chef, Nicola Fiasconaro. 
#DGLovesSicily #DolceGabbana #MadeInItaly
title: Touring the Sicilian piazzas with “Devotion”

description:
“Devotion”, the film by Giuseppe Tornatore, tells a story of a daily work completely devoted to the human touch, to that Beauty that machines, alone, will never be able to emulate.⠀
⠀
A path furrowed by joys, afterthoughts, brilliant intuitions and deep respect for tradition to be preserved from the wear and tear of time with the unrealeased music by the unforgettable Maestro Ennio Morricone.⠀
⠀
Yesterday the film was premièred at #TaorminaFilmFest with special guests such as Monica Bellucci and Il Volo
title: “Devotion”, the film by Giuseppe Tornatore

Live on Dolce&Gabbana’s Instagram profile and the official Camera Della Moda website on Wednesday, July 15th, at 5:30 PM CEST.

description:
Recalling the carefree atmosphere of the “Bella Vita”, the airy Alta Sartoria embroidered shirt is composed of a soft line and wide sleeves. Small, vibrant bouquets are made on sheets of linen, which are later sewn and assembled onto the final creation.  
 
#DGAltaSartoria #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly #DolceGabbana

description:
The artisan uses materials such as lurex fabric and crocheted raffia to create the Alta Moda look.  
Strengthened by the contrasts of gold details on a black georgette background, the final effect is elegant and unique.  
 
#DGAltaModa #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly #DolceGabbana

description:
Italian sophistication of the eccentric 1960s comes to life in the Alta Moda creation. The ruby red kaftan features detailed embroidery, which is embellished with crystals, half spheres, covered wooden elements and small flowers.   
 
#DGAltaModa #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly #DolceGabbana
title: Alta Moda ruby red embroidered Georgette kaftan – The Making Of

description:
The embroidery of the Alta Moda creation represents a silk mosaic, where every petal, flower and leaf is made entirely by hand from cut to finish. Inspired by the elegance and glamour of the sixties, the cady kimono consists of more than 40 shades of colour.  
 
#DGAltaModa #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly #DolceGabbana
title: Alta Moda embroidered cady kimono – The Making Of

description:
Inspired by garments of the sixteenth century, the Alta Sartoria creation features decorations made of black silk thread embroidery. The leaves on the jacket feature small patterns of multiple shapes and different profiles, which give the look an overall fluid and sophisticated composition.  
 
#DGAltaSartoria #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly #DolceGabbana
title: Alta Sartoria embroidered jacket – The Making Of

description:
The inspiration for this Alta Sartoria look comes from the stucco decorations typical of eighteenth-century Italian villas. In her home, the artist draws the elements of the robe coat’s composition and then paints them, creating three-dimensionality. 
 
#DGAltaSartoria #DGFattoInCasa #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly #DolceGabbana
title: Alta Sartoria printed and embroidered robe coat

description:
In his own home, our master artisan carefully embroiders garden-inspired motifs on the Alta Sartoria jacket. As a finishing touch, small blocks of contrasting colour are added to give greater detail to the desired design. 
 
#DGAltaSartoria #DGFattoInCasa #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly #DolceGabbana

description:

#DGAltaSartoria #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly #DolceGabbana

description:

description:

#DGAltaGioielleria #DGFattoAMano #MadeInItaly #DolceGabbana

description:
The scent opens with sparkling citrus top notes of Italian bergamot essence. Cassis adds a dark fruity facet, while pink pepper brings a spicy, rosy note. At the heart of the fragrance, comes Lily of the Valley, the delicate woodland flower that gives the scent its name. Warmed by the balmy rays of the Sicilian sun, it blends with creamy magnolia and earthy patchouli to reveal a generous blooming bouquet. This finally gives way to milky, sensual base notes of warm and resinous sandalwood and cashmeran wood, which capture the light of the island’s sun at its highest. 

Olfactory family : FLORAL FRUITY

description:
The starting point is no longer the outfit itself. It’s the desire to tell our story, reveal an emotion, a way of life.
In this way, people no longer purchase a piece of clothing but a memory, a love, a special moment, a DNA.
Our DNA is the South and all the symbols that represent it: flowers, pasta, bread, good luck charms, shells,
fish, religious symbols, music, ice cream, drinks, dolls, biscuits, forks, spoons, pizza and Mandolin.
All of this is love, is #DGFamily. #DGTropicoItaliano

description:
It’s from the private memories of Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana that the Dolce&Gabbana Velvet collection of exquisite Velvet perfumes was inspired. Velvet as an emblem for the history, fashion and personal recollections it brings together. It’s unique in its feel and appearance, and is sensual, evocative and hand-crafted. Just like the Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Collection perfumes.

Each of the twelve Velvet and two Velvet Oud perfumes are the fruit of a dedicated research into the ancient essences of Italian tradition, reinterpreted using contemporary perfume-making techniques and it brings the wearer on an unprecedented olfactory journey to discover the origins and the history of Dolce&Gabbana. Just like a couture dress.
title: THE VELVET COLLECTION

description:
Jazz, blues, swing, mambo, pop, dance, hip hop, reggae, all leave a mark in the moments of our life, certainly the beautiful ones that lead us to remember unforgettable, glamorous and special memories. 
Music is full of memories and history; it is timeless, ageless and placeless. We imagined being in Sicily (Taormina, Agrigento, Palermo), attending a festival, a concert, an event, under the palms of the Favorita’s or the Botanical Garden’s banana trees. In this magical atmosphere, the Sicilian Barocco’s golden yellow and Etna’s lava red passion merge. The light of sequins brings us to the glamorous atmosphere of La Dolce Vita. The mix and match of leopard, pineapples, musical instruments and dancing scenes prints are harmoniously mixed, in order to give a very personalized style to everyone as much as the music does. #DGMusica

Music by The Hot Sardines

description:
Discover uniqueness and ultimate luxury in Dolce&Gabbana’s The One and The One for Men Collector's Edition. 
The One Collector’s Edition takes inspiration from the iconic symbols treasured by the Designers. Each flacon bears the imprint of a gold coin, a strong motif in the Dolce&Gabbana’s fashion collection for 2014 representing a journey of discovery of ancient Sicily and the Greek culture that lies deep within its history. 
The One is a modern ‘floriental’ eau de parfum combining contemporary fruit ingredients with the perfumer’s classic palette of white flowers. While the One for Men is a concentrate of elegance and sensuality: a fragrance that is classic and modern, vibrant and engaging. An Oriental Spicy perfume which is developed from the harmony of Tobacco notes and refined spices.

description:
The Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Rose fragrance is the designers' homage to the Mediterranean rose. The scent is nourished by the freshest of water and the brightest of sun.
This soft rosy floral fragrance opens with a scent reminiscent of a fragrant sun-drenched sea breeze. Three vintage roses fuse together to make a feminine, floral masterpiece. Rich Moroccan Rose absolute, pure and airy Bulgarian Rose essence and light and crisp Rose Centifolia accord yield a natural rose scent that intoxicates and endures. 
Like delicate petals unfurling to reveal their dewy depths, the sensorial journey continues with Sicilian hesperidic notes of a Salomon Lily accord, and hints of Egyptian Geranium.

description:
Watch this interview with Martin Scorsese about his sixty seconds of film celebration of Dolce&Gabbana’s The One and The One for Men. His film ""Street of dreams"" stars Matthew McConaughey and Scarlett Johansson and features the song Il Cielo In Una Stanza by Mina.
"Street of dreams"" is an epic and unforgettable story about the power of love and the power of dreams. It is a story of Italy; of Hollywood; and of the world. Its classic cinematic style evokes both the grandeur of the golden years of Hollywood, and the passion and emotion of Europe's greatest cinema icons. 
The One scent combines contemporary fruit ingredients with the perfumer’s classic palette of white flowers. While the One for Men is a concentrate of elegance and sensuality: an Oriental Spicy perfume which is developed from the harmony of Tobacco notes and refined spices.

description:
The Dolce fragrance heralds an emotional and sensory journey through the heart of Dolce&Gabbana's DNA: the noble land of Sicily, which is seen in this film. 
Director Giuseppe Tornatore translates the Dolce world - and all the feelings it encapsulates - into an iconic film and interprets with elegance the finest nuances of the soul. 
The Dolce campaign represents a 'homecoming' for Tornatore to the brand, having collaborated with Stefano and Domenico in early Dolce&Gabbana fragrance campaigns. He represents the ideal choice to capture the spirit and history of the house, and the poetry of Dolce fragrance. 
The fragrance’s floral signature is counterbalanced by the background of warm Musky notes, along with the complex accents of Cashmeran; leaving a sensual trail of light woods, earthy tones and piquant spices.

A more intimate view of the behind the scenes and a chance to hear from their own words what Sartoria Estiva is.
title: SARTORIA ESTIVA as told by Dolce&Gabbana

description:
http://www.20anni.uomo.dolcegabbana.com

The Dolce&Gabbana Gentleman is turning 20 this month, so we are looking forward to a superb celebration on 19th June in Milan.
To pay tribute to their creations and to them as designers, their models and friends have joined voices to sing "Happy Birthday"; among them Brandon Wilson, Vladimir Ivanov, Emma I, Nikola Jovanovic, Roman Grafov, Andrei Zakharov, Neff Garrett + Terron Wood, Alex Cunha + Cristopher Meireles, Lindsay, Laurent Albucher + Julien Quevenne, Luis Kelling + Lukas Bossert, Arthur Kulkov, Natasha Poly, Andrea Preti, Ieva Laguna., Eugene Souleiman, Guy Robinson, Anna De Rijk, Eddie Wrey, David Gandy, Evandro Soldati.
It is sweet, spontaneous and sincere... Buon Compleanno, Bon Anniversaire, Happy Birthday Stefano and Domenico!
title: Happy Birthday... Mr Dolce&Gabbana

description:
Swide interviewed Claudio Marchisio during the making of the Calcio underwear advertising campaign. He revealed himself to be very spontaneous, superstitious and a family type of guy.
Claudio Marchisio is one of the 5 football players (Antonio Di Natale, Vincenzo Iaquinta, Federico Marchetti and Domenico Criscito) featured on the spring summer 2010 Dolce&Gabbana Calcio underwear campaign shot in front of a locker room shower stall by renown fashion photographer Mariano Vivanco.

description:
Fashion photographer Mariano Vivanco shared with Swide his thoughts about the Calcio advertising campaign photoshoot.

It is not the first time that he works for Dolce&Gabbana but on this occasion he had to shoot the Calcio underwear campaign that Swide revealed last month featuring five of our favourite Italian football players, Antonio Di Natale, Vincenzo Iaquinta, Claudio Marchisio, Federico Marchetti and Domenico Criscito.
title: Power To The People by Mariano Vivanco

Photographer lovebirds Scott Schuman (of the Sartorialist) and Garance Doré kindly agreed to discuss the dynamics of their enviable job and it became clear that for these two most things are life are done with passion and by putting their hearts into it. Simply adorable.

description: Swide caught up with hair legend Eugene Souleiman backstage at the Fall/Winter 2010-11 D&G men's show. While chatting to our favourite Briton we learnt a fundamental rule to managing your hair on a ski holiday: don't. Indeed Eugene's top tip was to embrace the mess and live blissfully ever after as snow bunnies.
title: Eugene Souleiman on messy ski hair backstage at D&G Winter 2011

description: Swide caught up with world-renowned hair stylist Eugene Souleiman backstage at the Dolce & Gabbana show where he shares his hairspirations behind the overall look of our models turned Sicilian actors and essential tips on how to achieve the retro look without looking like your dad.
title: Eugene talks hair backstage at Dolce&Gabbana Winter 2011 mens show

description: Backstage at the recent Dolce & Gabbana men's show we caught up with model-turned-promising actor Noah Mills in order to discuss his "other" day job and his experience on the set of Sex and the City II. And while it seems that Samantha's latest love interest may have found the lady a little intimidating at first he also confirmed the existence of some more "awkward" scenes. That Noah, such a tease!
title: Noah Mills on acting and Sex

description: We caught up with British actor Toby Kebbell at the last Dolce & Gabbana men's show and got comfy on the (very elegant) sofa with him to have a little chat about his new projects and what's in store for him this year.; we're happy to say we shall be seeing much more of him.  Needless to say our infatuation grew even deeper, such a gentleman!
title: Toby Kebbell at the Dolce & Gabbana men's show

description:
http://www.dolcegabbana.com/dg/fashion-show/

Sicilianità - Heritage - Going back to the roots.  Looking deeply at technology. Without the past, there can be no future. Baaria - Giuseppe Tornatores latest film masterpiece inspired this collection.  Sensuality - Softness ...- Sweetness - Smell - Love  All the things that make life sensual. Objects, time, places and memories.  Sartorialism - Cuts - Proportions - Volumes - Lines  Hand-stitched, tack. All the elements that characterise the Dolce&Gabbana style.
title: DOLCE&GABBANA'S YOUTUBE WINTER 2011 PRESS CONFERENCE

description:
Swide caught up with Baaria star Margareth Madè minutes before Dolce & Gabbana's F/W 2010-11 men's show, a show in which she became one of the stars as footage from the film accompanied the models on the catwalk.

In this exclusive interview she talks men, Sicily and the screen goddess she became for her latest role.
title: Margareth Madè on men, Sicily and icons
